title: Spinning top with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- top stem -->
  <rect x="46" y="8" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- stem highlight -->
  <rect x="48" y="10" width="3" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#FFE9A0"/>
  <!-- top knob -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="7" r="5" fill="#FF7043"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="5.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFB59E"/>

  <!-- top body (cone-ish spinning top shape) -->
  <path d="M28 38 Q50 14 72 38 L62 68 Q50 82 38 68 Z" fill="#29B6F6"/>
  <!-- lighter body panel for edge contrast -->
  <path d="M34 40 Q50 22 66 40 L58 64 Q50 74 42 64 Z" fill="#81D4FA"/>

  <!-- face area -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="44" r="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="44" r="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="45" r="2.2" fill="#1A237E"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="45" r="2.2" fill="#1A237E"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="43.5" r="0.9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="57.5" cy="43.5" r="0.9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M41 53 Q50 63 59 53" fill="none" stroke="#1A237E" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="52" r="3" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="52" r="3" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- tip of spinning top -->
  <path d="M44 72 L50 88 L56 72 Z" fill="#FB8C00"/>
  <path d="M47 72 L50 82 L53 72 Z" fill="#FFB74D"/>

  <!-- spin motion lines -->
  <path d="M18 50 Q14 46 18 42" fill="none" stroke="#B3E5FC" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M82 50 Q86 46 82 42" fill="none" stroke="#B3E5FC" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M22 60 Q18 58 20 54" fill="none" stroke="#B3E5FC" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M78 60 Q82 58 80 54" fill="none" stroke="#B3E5FC" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
